entries.name: CdTe / MWNT heterostructure
entries.caption: Illustrative CdTe nanocrystal attachment and junction architecture on oxygenated multiwalled nanotubes. Positions, colors, particle number and geometry are explanatory, not a measured interface or atomic model. Source predominantly assigns wurtzite CdTe with possible zinc blende and stacking faults; no refined interfacial coordinates are supplied.
limitations: Source-scoped identity or specimen schematic; no measured atomic coordinates.

provenance.identitySource: Inspected supplied main and matched IR supplement.
